resources.string: Remote control for this phone — ON only when you say so.
Status: OFF — using zero mobile data
Accessibility Service: OFF — taps and typing will not work.
Screen capture: not allowed — screenshots will not work.
Device Admin (for remote lock): OFF — remote lock will not work.
Sanji Control needs device admin ONLY to lock this phone remotely. Nothing else — no wipe, no password changes.
Tap the UID to copy it — enter it in the control panel to pick this phone.
Battery optimization: ON — the phone may kill the app in the background.
Battery optimization: Exempt — the app stays in the background.

On Oppo / ColorOS the phone also kills background apps unless you allow "Auto-start" and "Allow background running" for Sanji Control in the phone Settings → Apps. After a reboot the app restarts by itself only if it was ON — taps and typing keep working, but the screen needs "Start now" again (the screen permission is asked every time, Android rule).

When OFF, the app uses zero mobile data. When ON, the screen is streamed live (~4 frames/sec, JPEG quality 50, max width 540) only while a controller is connected; when no controller is connected, no frames are sent. Screen capture permission is asked every time the app is turned ON (Android privacy rule — device admin does not change this).
Lets Sanji Control tap, swipe and type on this phone when remote control is ON.
Remote control active — tap to open, or turn it OFF.
